## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the public API impact.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I tested keyboard and non-drag interaction when UI behavior changed.
- [ ] I tested relevant responsive/mobile states when UI behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated the changelog and documentation for public behavior.
- [ ] Portable core/editor changes do not depend on DOM or a UI framework.
- [ ] New research claims include primary sources, limits, and reproducible fixtures.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before/after evidence for visual changes, or write “Not applicable.”
